function parse(s) { return JSON.parse(s); }
function load() {
  try { parse("{bad"); } catch (e) { throw new Error("config load failed", { cause: e }); }
}
const fs = require("fs");
process.on("uncaughtExceptionMonitor", (e) => {
  fs.writeFileSync(process.env.OUT, JSON.stringify({ outer: e.stack, cause: e.cause.stack, name: e.name, cname: e.cause.name, cmsg: e.cause.message, msg: e.message }));
});
load();
